integrity: Infinite assertions proved from explicit orbit-support arguments, the cited connectivity and orbit-space theorems, and Cartan-Leray; finite checks are corroboration only. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Determines fundamental groups of dihedral-subgroup orbit spaces for n>=6 and only low integral homology of full rotation quotients for primes p>=7; no full quotient homotopy classification or higher-degree integral groups.
title: Prime-power fundamental groups and unbounded torsion in bidirected-polygon orbit spaces
